12: MATRYÓNA [ comes out of the hut and down the steps of the porch to Anísya and Nikíta ] Don't go anywhere. He's got the money on him. I felt it on a string round his neck.
10: ANÍSYA. Oh, my poor head! I'll go and have a look there. [ Nikíta steps aside ].
8: NIKÍTA. I saw him coming from there, but where he's shoved it to, who can tell?
6: ANÍSYA. Oh, Nikíta darling! he's sent for his sister, and wants to give it to her. It will be a bad lookout for us. How are we going to live, if he gives her the money? They'll turn me out of the house! You try and manage somehow! You said he went to the shed last night.
5: ANÍSYA. If he dies, and the money's been hidden away … NIKÍTA. No fear, he'll not hide it …
4: NIKÍTA. What are you to be pitied for?
2: ANÍSYA. Look at him,—seized with pity! He has found someone to pity too! He's been treating you like a dog, and even just now was giving orders to have you turned out of the house. You'd better show me some pity!
1: NIKÍTA. I am sorry for him,—that sorry. How he cried! Oh dear!
0: NIKÍTA [ angrily ] How should I know? Go and look for it yourself! ANÍSYA. What's made you so tender?
